title: I posted this the other day in dream sub, I think it will get more reception here though?
content: I think I was trying to lucid dream to the Airport realm or whatever and got stuck in a hospital, my hands were clasping each other so tightly that they were cracking and my skin was peeling away from itself, and Everytime I took a step, giant mass of purple ooze came out of my feet. Anyone make anything out of it?
